payload.text: Use PostgreSQL for the primary datastore
payload.reason: ACID compliance, team familiarity, mature ecosystem. SQLite considered but ruled out for concurrent write workloads.
payload.author: architect

payload.text: REST over gRPC for the public API
payload.reason: Browser clients need REST; gRPC adds tooling overhead for a 2-person team. Revisit if internal service mesh grows.
payload.author: architect

payload.reason: Version-controlled, idempotent, CI-friendly. Avoids ORM magic.
payload.author: developer

payload.text: JWT for authentication, 15-minute access token + 7-day refresh token
payload.reason: Stateless auth scales horizontally. Short access TTL limits blast radius of leaked tokens.
payload.author: architect

payload.text: Do NOT store raw passwords — bcrypt with cost factor 12
payload.reason: bcrypt is purposefully slow; cost 12 takes ~250ms on reference hardware, acceptable for auth flows.
payload.author: architect

payload.text: Rate-limit /auth/login to 5 attempts per minute per IP
payload.reason: Brute-force mitigation. Implemented in middleware before handler so it applies to all auth routes.
payload.author: developer

payload.text: Structured JSON logging with zerolog — no fmt.Println in handlers
payload.reason: Machine-parseable logs for production observability. zerolog has zero-allocation hot path.
payload.author: developer

payload.text: Integration tests use a real Postgres container (testcontainers-go), not mocks
payload.reason: Mock divergence burned us Q4 — mocked tests passed, prod migration failed. Testcontainers gives real DB behavior.
payload.author: developer
